assumptions: Input price is a hypothetical tax-inclusive transaction price before coupon; no additional markdown is simulated. Section 4.1 display-price derivation and 25% pricing target do not set the actual transaction price.

Apply seller-funded coupon once to the input price. All specified percentage fees including withdrawal use the coupon-discounted, tax-inclusive buyer payment as a synthetic fee base. Actual settlement fee bases are unverified.
Cost of sales comprises the fictional arrival cost plus weight-based freight and CNY 2 per unit. MY CNY 0.81 support charge is an additional per-unit fee.
Both margin ratios use tax-exclusive revenue after the coupon as denominator. The coupon8 gross margin threshold is compared before formatting.

Use only the newer profile's listed fees. Other fees and returns are outside this synthetic calculation; no older-profile charges are imported. The new profile sets affiliate fee to 0% in both markets.
